create_script_vocabulary: create a ScriptVocabulary instance from a list of words with configurable special token indices
lookup_indices_1d: convert a list of words into their corresponding vocabulary indices using lookup_indices_1d
lookup_indices_2d: convert a nested list of word lists into 2D vocabulary indices using lookup_indices_2d
lookup_words_1d: convert a 1D tensor of indices back into words using lookup_words_1d with optional filtering
lookup_word: look up a single word by its vocabulary index using the lookup_word method
